title: AI-Driven RF-Based Object Detection and Classification for 5G-Advanced and Beyond
summary: HFCL proposes AI-based radio-frequency sensing that detects and classifies objects for telecom, transport, manufacturing, and monitoring, and reports no testbed result.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: HFCL proposes a system that uses radio signals to detect and classify objects, including where optical sensors are limited. Its proposed applications include traffic, maintenance, infrastructure monitoring, and security. In the 2025 ITU report, current as of June 2025, HFCL lists no testbed or pilot deployment for the system and gives no measured benefit. It names IIT Delhi only as a potential partner. HFCL submitted two use cases to the ITU interim report of 2026. Both cover other network projects, and neither reports a test or result for radio-frequency object detection.
purpose: Use radio-frequency sensing to support detection and monitoring tasks.
